key_facts: July 7 update (Moldpres 17:14, Reuters/Straits Times, Logos Press, bne IntelliNews): President Maia Sandu signed a presidential decree on July 7 appointing Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economic Development & Digitalization Eugeniu Osmochescu (former IFC/World Bank official) as acting prime minister effective July 8 until a new government is invested. Acting status itself does NOT resolve the question, and Sandu has NOT yet held parliamentary faction consultations (still scheduled for later this week; PSRM and MAN boycotting, PAS majority in control). However, Logos Press reports government-circle sources say outgoing PM Alexandru Munteanu recommended Osmochescu as caretaker and that Osmochescu may also be considered as a candidate for prime minister with a full mandate if political consensus forms. Added Eugeniu Osmochescu to top 5 at 0.16 (replacing Mihai Popșoi, who was passed over for acting PM and drops to ~0.05 outside top 5), while trimming Dan Perciun 0.20->0.17, Adrian Băluțel 0.15->0.13, Vasile Tofan 0.14->0.12, Igor Grosu 0.11->0.10; sum 0.68 leaving 0.32 outside mass (Popșoi, Gherasimov, Bolea, or surprise PAS/outside pick).
next_review_trigger: URGENT daily check July 8+: watch for Sandu faction consultations, PAS official PM nominee announcement, presidential designation decree, and Parliament investiture vote.
